title: Why Jesse and Son Is the Best Tailor in Bangkok – According to Our Clients
description: When people search for the best tailor in Bangkok, they want trust, quality, and personal care. With over 1,600 five-star reviews, Jesse and Son delivers every time.
html:
When people search for the best tailor in Bangkok, they want trust, quality, and personal care. With over 1,600 five-star reviews, Jesse and Son delivers every time.

We’re a family-run tailor — no outsourcing, no salespeople. Every client is fitted by me or my brother Nick, and we never upsell. We’re more particular than our clients because perfection matters.

We own our workshop with 25 full-time tailors and an in-store QC team. Every suit, shirt, and jacket is cut, constructed, and checked in-house — then personally approved by me.

We use premium materials: horn, corozo, and mother-of-pearl buttons, Japanese threads, German equipment, and rare Milanese buttonholes. Half canvas is our standard; full canvas is available.

Every garment is drafted from scratch, with 2–3 fittings for a perfect fit. We also offer express bespoke service in 48–72 hours.

Clients say: “The best tailor in Bangkok, no doubt. Attention to detail and service unmatched.”
